title: EL FUTURO CON GOING TO
subtitle: Be going to · planes y predicciones

map.center: Usamos BE GOING TO + verbo para hablar de planes ya decididos y de cosas que vemos que van a pasar.

nodes.title: Predicciones

explain.es: Be going to es como decir «voy a…» en español: Voy a jugar = I'm going to play. Lo usamos para dos cosas: planes que ya hemos decidido (mañana voy a ver a mi abuela) y predicciones cuando vemos pistas de que algo va a pasar (¡mira esas nubes, va a llover!). Se forma con el verbo to be + going to + un verbo en infinitivo.
explain.en: Be going to = «voy a…». We use it for plans and for predictions when we can see something is going to happen.

explain.title: 1 · Planes e intenciones
explain.es: Cuando ya has decidido hacer algo (antes de hablar), usa going to. Muchas veces va con una palabra de futuro: tomorrow, next week, this weekend.
explain.en: Use going to for things you have already decided to do.
formula: I + *'m going to* + visit my grandma

examples.en: I'm going to visit my grandma tomorrow.
examples.es: Mañana voy a visitar a mi abuela.

examples.en: We're going to play football after school.
examples.es: Vamos a jugar al fútbol después del cole.

examples.en: Lucía is going to learn to swim this summer.
examples.es: Lucía va a aprender a nadar este verano.

explain.title: 2 · Predicciones con pistas
explain.es: También usamos going to cuando vemos pistas de que algo va a pasar muy pronto. Es como ser un detective 🕵️: miras, ves una prueba y dices lo que va a pasar.
explain.en: We also use going to when we can see that something is going to happen.

examples.en: Look at those black clouds! It's going to rain.
examples.es: ¡Mira esas nubes negras! Va a llover.

examples.en: Leo is running very fast. He's going to win!
examples.es: Leo corre muy rápido. ¡Va a ganar!

explain.title: 3 · Afirmativa
head: Forma larga · Long
Forma corta · Short
explain.note: Después de going to el verbo va en infinitivo: sin -s, sin -ing, sin -ed. She's going to play (no plays, no playing). En canciones oirás gonna = going to, ¡pero no lo escribas en el cole!
explain.note_en: After going to, use the base verb: no -s, no -ing.

explain.title: 4 · Negativa
explain.es: Para la negativa ponemos not después de am / is / are: I'm not, isn't, aren't + going to + verbo. ¡No uses don't ni no!
explain.en: Put not after am / is / are: I'm not / isn't / aren't going to.
formula: he / she / it + *isn't* + going to + verbo
you / we / they + *aren't* + going to + verbo

examples.en: Tom isn't going to come to the party.
examples.es: Tom no va a venir a la fiesta.

examples.en: We aren't going to watch TV tonight.
examples.es: Esta noche no vamos a ver la tele.

explain.title: 5 · Preguntas
explain.es: Para preguntar, el verbo to be salta delante del sujeto (¡como el Verbo Saltarín!): Are you going to…? Is she going to…? Con What, Where, When, Who, esa palabra va la primera.
explain.en: Questions: Am / Is / Are + subject + going to + verb? With Wh- words: What are you going to do?
formula: *Am / Is / Are* + sujeto + going to + verbo?
*What / Where / When* + are + you + going to + verbo?

examples.en: Are you going to play tennis tomorrow?
What are you going to do this weekend?
examples.es: ¿Qué vas a hacer este fin de semana?

examples.en: Where are they going to go on holiday?

explain.title: 6 · Respuestas cortas
head: Pregunta · Question
Sí · Yes
No
explain.note: En la respuesta corta no repetimos going to: Yes, I am going to. → Yes, I am. Y nunca contraemos el sí: Yes, I'm.
explain.note_en: Short answers: no going to, and no short form in yes answers.

explain.title: ¿Plan o predicción?
explain.es: Las dos usan going to. La diferencia: un plan depende de ti (ya lo has decidido). Una predicción depende de lo que ves (hay pistas).
explain.en: Plan = you have decided it. Prediction = you can see the evidence.

explain.title: Truco: «voy a…» = going to
explain.es: Si en español dices «voy a…», «vas a…», «va a…», en inglés casi siempre es going to: Voy a comer → I'm going to eat. ¿Vas a venir? → Are you going to come? Y recuerda la fórmula mágica: am / is / are + going to + verbo limpio (sin -s, sin -ing). 🧼
explain.en: «voy a…» → I'm going to… Remember: am / is / are + going to + clean verb.

text: Hi! I'm Mario. The school year is nearly over, and I've got big plans for the summer! In July, my family and I are going to go to Asturias. We're going to stay in a small house near the beach.
My sister Lucía is going to take surfing lessons. I'm not going to surf, because I'm a bit scared! I'm going to swim and play football on the beach with my cousins.
In August, my friend Leo is going to come to our house. We're going to ride our bikes and build a treehouse in the garden. Rocky isn't going to help… he's going to sleep under the tree!
